 Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Ind:35737

 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Binod Kumar Dwivedi
 On The 12th Of December, 2024

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Smt. Sushilabai And Others
 Versus
 Sanjay Narwale And Others
 Appearance:

Shri Jitendra Shejwar, learned counsel for the applic
 Shri Punit Verma, learned counsel for the respondents
 Shri Kratik Mandloi, learned Panel Lawyer for the res
 Order

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C has been filed for quashment of FIR at Crime No.133/2015 dated 27.02.2015 for offence under Sections 420,467,468,471,472,473 and 120-B of IPC, registered at Police Station Bhawarkua, district Indore.

2. The applicants and complainants Sanjay Narwale S/o Virendra Narwale, Smt.Varsha Narwale W/o Sanjay Narwale and Virendra Narwale S/o Bholramji Narwale have entered into compromise which was filed before the learned trial Court where the applicants have been acquitted of the charges under Section 420 read with Section 120-B of IPC with observation that trial for offence under Sections 467,468,471 and 120-B of IPC will continue as the aforesaid offences are non-compoundable.

3. Before this Court, document no.8105/2024 was filed and it was NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:35737 2 MCRC-21534-2023 placed before the Principal Registrar of this Court to verify the factum of compromise.

The Principal Registrar of this Court vide report dated 21.08.2024 submitted that both the parties have entered into compromise voluntarily, without any threat,
inducement and coercion and they have resolved their dispute.

4. Since parties have settled their dispute, therefore in terms of compromise petition, FIR at Crime No.133/2015 dated 27.02.2015, registered at Police Station Bhawarkua, district Indore and subsequent proceedings are hereby quashed.
Accordingly, this petition stands disposed off.
